reviewer_statement: Scoped source scientific data and plotting-artist developer review. Native R registered trajectories/warp geometry and direct pinned Python 1.2 source artist comparisons are committed. Exact-head differential CI and external certification are not yet verified; native R cannot return Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure instances.
native_language_semantic_policy: Only observed scientific line coordinates, figure panel count/metadata, source labels/opacity and source identity/displacement definitions are represented. The native base graphics object is not Python Matplotlib, and exception/axes mutation/pixel parity remain out of scope.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_reconstruction_curve. No R implementation reuses Python runtime plotting classes.

Accepts data.frame with observed n_components nonnegative integers and finite nonnegative mean_integrated_rmse, including unsorted source rows. Strict source mode must be a nonmissing logical scalar. The native renderer does not accept Matplotlib ax injection or return actual Python Axes objects.

Actual x=n_components and y=mean_integrated_rmse from each original data row are stored exactly, with source marker 'o' and connecting line, the source title 'FPCA reconstruction curve' and both source axes labels. Direct pinned Python 1.2 public Matplotlib line get_xydata comparisons on unsorted source values committed; successful exact-head CI not yet observed.

Missing original reconstruction columns, negative/noninteger components, invalid/nonfinite RMSE or nonlogical strict flag fail closed; Python backend ValueError types and external Axes protocol not matched.

Python returns a Matplotlib Axes with source Line2D. Native strict R returns inspectable one-panel scientific artist record, original coordinates and labels. Base R graphics remains the renderer; default numeric dataframe return remains unchanged, no Python Axes runtime identity/pixel parity.
Observed integrated FPCA reconstruction error as retained component count varies, retaining original source row order without unsanctioned sorting or interpolation.

independent_review_status: Author-scoped provisional scientific-geometry review; pinned Python exact-head tests queued/unverified, zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: R base graphics and source data do not recreate Python Figure/Axes runtime object identity, exceptions, or pixel-equivalent rendering.
Supported source-scientific geometry scope is restricted to complete native registration and original observed reconstruction summary; full Python input/ax domain remains different.
No independently checked numerical end-to-end registration certification, main-branch merge or CRAN qualification asserted.
